name: CreateProcCorrectOrder

parameters.help_en: The operators that are related to the ticket
parameters.name: related_user_list

fields.help_en: The reason for the programmable object change
fields.name: classify

fields.help_en:
The database ID. Databases are divided into physical databases and logical databases.

To query the ID of a physical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation.
To query the ID of a logical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation
fields.help_zh:
数据库ID（DatabaseId）。数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：
物理库ID：可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值。
逻辑库ID：可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值
fields.name: db_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.
false: The database is a physical database
fields.help_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值如下：
true：逻辑库
false：物理库
fields.name: logic

fields.help_en:
The mode in which the data change ticket is executed after the ticket is approved. Valid values:

COMMITOR: The ticket is executed by the user who submits the ticket.
AUTO: The ticket is automatically executed after the ticket is approved.
LAST_AUDITOR: The ticket is executed by the last approver of the ticket
fields.help_zh:
工单执行方式，取值如下：

COMMITOR : 审批通过后，提交者执行。
AUTO : 审批通过后，自动执行。
LAST_AUDITOR : 审批通过后，最后一个审批人执行
fields.name: exec_mode

fields.example:
DELIMITER ///
CREATE PROCEDURE GetAllProducts()
BEGIN
SELECT *  FROM base_user;
END ///
fields.help_en: The SQL statements for data change
fields.name: exec_sql

fields.help_en:
The key of the attachment that contains the SQL statements used to roll back the data change. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to obtain the attachment key from the value of AttachmentKey.

This parameter is required if you set RollbackSqlType to ATTACHMENT
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL附件Key（AttachmentKey），可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html接口获取该参数的值。

如果RollbackSqlType为ATTACHMENT，该参数必填
fields.name: rollback_attachment_name

fields.help_en:
The SQL statements for rolling back the data change.

This parameter is required if you set the RollbackSqlType parameter to TEXT
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL语句。
如果RollbackSqlType为TEXT，该参数必填
fields.name: rollback_sql

fields.help_en:
The format of the SQL statements used to roll back the data change. Valid values:

TEXT
ATTACHMENT
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL的提交方式，取值如下：
TEXT：文本
ATTACHMENT：附件
fields.name: rollback_sql_type

parameters.help_en:
The key of the attachment for the ticket. The attachment provides more instructions for this operation.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to query the key of the attachment
parameters.help_zh:
工单补充附件，对本次操作进行补充说明。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: attachment_key

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid
